resolvedFindings.evidence: Both returned global and selected node-project rootDir explicitly use the canonical target root.

Controller and stage intents precede stage/spawn; immutable child birth and outcome hashes link to owner/boot. Auditor enumerates every namespace, requires complete original stage evidence and holds missing receipts or successful-install/no-completed-witness.

F3StageImprovements: Absolute grant/stage/cleanup and monotonic stops now cover stage launch, races, close/drain and post-outcome checks; drain is capped at2s under remaining cleanup time.

findings.title: Reject late controller finalization before accepting a successful receipt
findings.body: Stage expiry checks now cover spawn, races, close, drain and stage outcome persistence, but main sets the successful witness state before finally restores the fixture, hashes 19 inputs, runs three Git commands (each may take10s), and writes its receipt/manifest. Those operations have no remaining-grant timeout or final expiry check. A natural stage near its relative stop can leave about20s before grant expiry while three successful8s Git commands make the controller finish late with the successful state. The separate release audit checks stage outcome time but never compares controller receipt endedAt/endedAtUtc with the assigned expiry; it can issue RELEASED, and the250 prerequisite accepts the successful100 receipt. This is a source counterexample, not an executed witness.
findings.correction: Carry an absolute UTC and monotonic controller stop through post-stage source restoration/audits and terminal evidence persistence, cap Git operations by remaining time, and refuse or downgrade late completion. Bind the final controller deadline/outcome evidence to the assignment and require it in the separate release audit and100 predecessor acceptance; preserve late or incomplete receipts as partial evidence.

disposition: Source not ready for a100 hosted dispatch until the remaining controller-terminal deadline gap is corrected and independently reviewed. No diagnostic grant, publication or dispatch is inferred.
